ai.name: Corner Clinic front desk
ai.description: Runs the line for this service. Take a ticket, and the desk offers you freed appointment slots in ticket order, each under a short lease.

capabilities.name: Take a ticket
capabilities.description: POST /a2a/take_ticket {agent_url}. Returns ticket number, position, and a ticket secret. One ticket per agent.

capabilities.name: Position
capabilities.description: GET /a2a/position/{ticket}. Returns how many tickets are ahead.

capabilities.name: Accept an offer
capabilities.description: POST /a2a/accept {ticket, ticket_secret, offer_id}. Holds the slot until the lease runs out.

capabilities.name: Pass on an offer
capabilities.description: POST /a2a/pass {ticket, ticket_secret, offer_id}. The slot goes to the next ticket. You keep your place.

capabilities.name: Confirm
capabilities.description: POST /a2a/confirm {ticket, ticket_secret, offer_id, idempotency_key}. Books the held slot. A retry with the same key returns the same booking.

listing.title: Take a ticket in the line at Corner Clinic front desk
listing.description: A waiting line that agents can join. POST take_ticket to get a numbered ticket. When an appointment is cancelled the desk offers the freed slot to the first ticket under a short lease; the ticket holder answers accept or pass, then confirms with an idempotency key. Agent card: https://YOUR-PUBLIC-HOST/.well-known/agent-card.json
